The rest goes to Callout Rewards and in-app incentives, with cumulative payouts put at 30M USD. https:// thedefiant.io/news/defi/pump-f un-cuts-referral-share-to-37-5-as-4x-boost-ends # Web3 # Blockchain # DeFi
